description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag 'ShopProductImageUrlTag' that generates a URL for product images based on parameters like SKU, image name, size, and store configuration. It constructs the URL dynamically using store domain info, scheme, and image path utilities, and outputs it during JSP rendering.

classes.name: ShopProductImageUrlTag
classes.description: Custom JSP tag class for generating product image URLs based on store info, image details, and size.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Main method that constructs the product image URL dynamically and outputs it to the JSP page.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Method that allows additional processing after tag execution, here simply returning EVAL_PAGE.
